description:
One day before receiving a massive sum of 19.5 billion won, the protagonist, An Ji-Heon, is murdered by hitmen. When he opens his eyes again, he instinctively realizes that something he’s only ever seen in movies is happening to him. 

A time travel journey that goes backward one day at a time! When he wakes up, it’s not tomorrow—it’s yesterday. But the novelty wears off quickly. With 19.5 billion won just within reach, Ji-Heon, who finds himself drifting further away from it with each passing day, resolves to escape this phenomenon by any means necessary, regardless of whether it’s time travel or not. 

*“I can’t just sit here and turn into a newborn baby. I’m getting my 19.5 billion won back, no matter what!!”*

The protagonist, An Ji-Heon’s, blood, sweat, and tears-filled journey to escape ‘The Minus’ begins.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
